question: In a certain code language, 'TABLE' is coded as '10177625'. How will 'GLOBAL' be coded in that laguage?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/O-8dyIBISvx5o12SRtu7LEU3MrfmUur0K7yvnZtsglByfUu2KE50xGcq6Fq_nOEKo4KE6Pi8qp1t_qIoWZP27wlcEhkexo6SLy4EV_7f2vEMLUJBvfvnqxEzTXkOURl8Qxk2a4F4lUwkwpyJZID43g] 

**Logic: Addition of + 5 in every alphabet then arrange in reverse order.**

'TABLE' is coded as '10177625" 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28353aa0ac66c1b4576d88b12a4f73ee0d1481fe2b6b4832e21780f91c563467.png] 

Similarly,

'GLOBAL' is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/923cd240bccd35dcea8f4a17a855244aa915c4988debe2a322c2f9823d38accc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "1767201712".
